messages:
sanjay: starting a staged canary for rwd-v6-q4a-compact. plan: micro-shadow (30m) -> 0.5% -> 3% -> 15%. want clear warning hooks and a hard auto-fallback. posting draft gate config.

paula: sounds good. prefer relative percent thresholds for quality (MRR) and absolute for hallucination-pp since small absolute bumps matter. propose: warn at MRR_drop_pct 0.7, rollback at 1.8. halluc_pp_increase warn 0.15, rollback 0.4. latency_p99 increase rollback at 60ms.

mira: please add a rerank slice (RERANK-MRR) and longprompt slice (LP-MRR). longprompt needs longer eval window (45m) because traffic is sparse. also add a min-sample requirement per slice (>=5k) so we don't act on tiny numbers.

sanjay: yes to min-samples. adding a 10min stabilization window per step except longprompt which is 45m. also adding a soft-warning webhook to #canary-alerts for early eyeballs. schedule a 30m preflight smoke (1k queries across 4 slices) before first percent step.

rollout snippet (for console ingestion):
```
rollout_id: RL-20260323-78
model: rwd-v6-q4a-compact
strategy:
  - phase: micro-shadow
    duration: 00:30:00
  - phase: canary
    steps:
      - percent: 0.5
        duration: 00:20:00
      - percent: 3
        duration: 01:00:00
      - percent: 15
        duration: 01:10:00
auto_fallback:
  warnings:
    - metric: MRR
      comparator: relative_decrease
      threshold_pct: 0.7
    - metric: HALLUC_PP
      comparator: absolute_increase
      threshold_pp: 0.15
  hard_fail:
    - metric: MRR
      comparator: relative_decrease
      threshold_pct: 1.8
    - metric: HALLUC_PP
      comparator: absolute_increase
      threshold_pp: 0.4
    - metric: LATENCY_P99
      comparator: absolute_increase_ms
      threshold_ms: 60
slices:
  - name: rerank
    metric: MRR
    comparator: relative_decrease
    threshold_pct: 2.0
    min_samples: 5000
    eval_window: 15m
  - name: longprompt
    metric: MRR
    comparator: relative_decrease
    threshold_pct: 2.5
    min_samples: 5000
    eval_window: 45m
general:
  min_samples_per_step: 2000
  step_eval_window: 10m
  preflight_smoke: true
  preflight_queries: 1000
```

paula: minor ask 1 can we require two independent metrics to hit hard_fail before auto-rollback for the 0.5% step? reduces noisy single-metric bump rollbacks.

mira: that's reasonable for the first tiny step. require concurrence on small steps, but single-metric hard-fail allowed on >=3% steps. add that to config as `require_concurrent_failures_for_small_steps: true`.

sanjay: updated locally. I'll kick micro-shadow after mira confirms slice exports.

deploy-bot: created RL-20260323-78 in staging. manual start required at /console/rollouts/RL-20260323-78. runbook link: https://console.internal/runbooks/canary-gates.

ops-bot: tagging ops oncall window (3h). watching node pressure and preempt counts. will escalate if queue depth > 500 on any node.

sanjay: next actions: mira export slice defs + min-sample checks (ETA 30m), paula add webhook to #canary-alerts (ETA 20m), sanjay to run preflight smoke and then start micro-shadow (ETA 50m).
